Page numbers are sets of Arabic numerals with "t." (tomus/tome) references; kept as printed. A faint stain sits beside the "Ordines" entry and near "Origenistarum"; the reading there is clear. The "Pontificiis" and "Ecclesiæ" forms are kept as printed. The last line continues on the next part of the page. Greek words in the lines "διατακτικὰ" and "ἰυταξίαν" are doubtful and marked [?].
